availableCommands.name: claude-code-plugins
availableCommands.description: Claude Code plugin mechanics, verified against v2.1.220 — do not answer from memory, the details change per release. TRIGGER whenever the task involves: plugin.json, marketplace.json, .claude-plugin/, hooks/hooks.json, .mcp.json, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, SKILL.md frontmatter, skills-dir; the `claude plugin` CLI (init, install, validate, details, marketplace, tag, eval); /reload-plugins or /reload-skills; --plugin-dir or --plugin-url; a plugin, skill, hook, subagent, slash command, or plugin MCP server that isn't loading, isn't firing, or isn't discoverable; or testing/iterating on plugin changes without restarting the session.

availableCommands.name: cover-letter-writing
availableCommands.description: Use when writing a cover letter, cold email to a company/founder/PI, or outreach message for a job/internship/research position. Covers both formal cover letters and cold emails, personalized to Ryan Kim's candidate profile.

availableCommands.name: customize-opencode
availableCommands.description: Use ONLY when the user is editing or creating opencode's own configuration: opencode.json, opencode.jsonc, files under .opencode/, or files under ~/.config/opencode/. Also use when creating or fixing opencode agents, subagents, skills, plugins, MCP servers, or permission rules. Do not use for the user's own application code, or for any project that is not configuring opencode itself.

availableCommands.name: dispatching-parallel-agents

availableCommands.name: executing-plans

availableCommands.name: find-skills
availableCommands.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

availableCommands.name: finishing-a-development-branch
availableCommands.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work - guides completion of development work by presenting structured options for merge, PR, or cleanup

availableCommands.name: frontend-design
availableCommands.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

availableCommands.name: handoff
availableCommands.description: Compact the current conversation into a detailed handoff file — everything that happened, why it happened, and what's left — written to disk for a fresh agent session. Use when hitting context limits, switching focus, ending a work session, or partitioning a task across fresh contexts.

availableCommands.name: humanizer
availableCommands.description:
Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing
text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's
comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including:
inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague
attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive
voice, negative parallelisms, and filler phrases.

availableCommands.name: incident
availableCommands.description: Incident Knowledge — list patterns, trigger Fix Now, monitor remediation. Usage: /incident <list|show|fix|monitor|track|refresh> [flags]

availableCommands.name: init
availableCommands.description: guided AGENTS.md setup

availableCommands.name: mcp2cli
availableCommands.description: Turn any MCP server, OpenAPI spec, or GraphQL endpoint into a CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to interact with an MCP server, OpenAPI/REST API, or GraphQL API via command line, discover available tools/endpoints, call API operations, or generate a new skill from an API. Triggers include "mcp2cli", "call this MCP server", "use this API", "list tools from", "create a skill for this API", "graphql", or any task involving MCP tool invocation, OpenAPI endpoint calls, or GraphQL queries without writing code.

availableCommands.name: mem-search
availableCommands.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

availableCommands.name: playwright-cli

availableCommands.name: playwright-skill
availableCommands.description: Complete browser automation with Playwright. Auto-detects dev servers, writes clean test scripts to /tmp. Use when user wants to test websites, automate browser interactions, validate web functionality, or perform any browser-based testing.
